'''Poe''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] owned by Grand Duke [[Gror Pernon]]. He acted as [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]] diplomatic liaison to the people of [[Eiattu 6]].

He later served on [[Elshandruu Pica]] as a valet in a resort, where his past connection to Rogue Squadron helped [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] get close to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sair Yonka]] and convince him to defect.<ref name="bw" />
